questions.q: What is the main function of protein?
questions.why: Protein is used for growth and repair, e.g. muscle.
Glucose is stored as glycogen in muscles and the liver.

questions.q: A person takes in more energy than they use. What happens to the extra energy?
questions.why: Unused energy is stored as fat, which can lead to obesity.

questions.q: Explain why a marathon runner eats a high-carbohydrate meal before a race.
questions.model: Carbohydrate is broken down to glucose and stored as glycogen in muscles and liver. This gives a bigger energy store so aerobic respiration can continue longer and fatigue is delayed.
points: carbohydrate gives glucose / stored as glycogen
energy store lasts longer / delays fatigue
